name: com.unpseudo.autoplay
description: Runs whole games without humans: a game adapter plays every seat through the real code paths, the runner tracks phases, detects stalls, writes a report, a live event trace and state files at capture points (+ screenshots when rendering). Dev builds can self-run with -autoplay and stay out of the user's way (no focus stealing, no cursor lock, muted). Editor and Development builds only.
